payload.session: uuid — the session the scene belongs to
payload.scene: uuid — the scene given its instance; it has none yet (one-instance-per-scene), and its instance's id is derived from it, so the scene is the command's idempotency key (`table.createBattlemapInstance:<scene>`)
payload.battlemap: uuid — a battlemap media of the session's campaign, read and never written (instance-isolated)
